payloadRole: Top-level payload is chk-summary.log, the tool-check summary at the clean exact merge b78909c5e (one line per command with exit code, start and end). additionalPayloads are byte copies of the npm ci logs (the aborted first attempt and the real one), the built-image run output (summary, manifest, evidence.jsonl, the server logs), the inspection and git-fact notes, and the tool-check logs. G-OWN: no tracked trace, log, screenshot or DB file; raw output stays outside Git.

additionalPayloads.name: npm-ci-aborted.log
additionalPayloads.note: first npm ci, started by mistake outside the queue by the worker and stopped after about 3 minutes (own PIDs only); discarded, the real npm ci below ran as a build ticket

additionalPayloads.name: npm-ci.log
additionalPayloads.note: real npm ci in the clean checkout (heavy-run build ticket); the trailing exit= line is appended by the ticket wrapper script

additionalPayloads.name: inspect-run.txt
additionalPayloads.note: witness sequence, image hashes and file hashes computed from the run output

additionalPayloads.name: git-facts.txt
additionalPayloads.note: ancestry, tree equality and leaf blob identities at the clean exact merge

additionalPayloads.name: next-env-after-build.diff
